# Exercise calling a txtar script with isolated files and environment.
env SCENARIO_PARAM=parent
env CALL_LEAK=parent
withenv SCENARIO_PARAM=hello {
  call $DATADIR/called.txtar
}

# Environment and working-directory changes in the called script are restored.
env SCENARIO_PARAM
stdout '^SCENARIO_PARAM=parent$'
env CALL_LEAK
stdout '^CALL_LEAK=parent$'
exists parent-fixture.txt

-- parent-fixture.txt --
from parent
